Definition: the breast (as most seen in front)
BiblicalUsage: The breast is the wave offering, the priest's portion of the sacrifice. Moses takes the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration and waves it before the LORD, the law gives the breast to Aaron and his sons, and the wave breast is eaten in a clean place by the priest's household.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds His priests from His own altar. The breast waved before Him comes back as their due, and worship and provision are one act.
